items.text:
Hi Ines,

I wrote to you on 2 October about the Velmora store’s load time, and I do not want to push, so this is the last time I write about it.
Two things have changed since then. Yesterday the home page took 6.4 seconds, a little more than before, because a 3 MB clearance banner was added.
Google also now shows the store with a warning that it is slow on phones, which it did not do before.
I measured from a mid-range phone on mobile data at 11 in the morning, the same as the first time, so the two numbers can be compared.
The two-page note is still there. If it is useful, I can send it today at no cost, and you can use it with whoever builds the site, me or someone else.
If someone else looks after this, tell me who and I will write to them. If now is not the time, that helps me too.

Best,
Tom

items.text:
Subject: Re: Quote for the Copo North site

Hi Mark,

Following up on our call, I kept thinking about what you said about the season.
If the site has to be ready before 15 November, the safest plan is to split it in two.
First the home page, the product page and the order form, which is what your wholesale buyers use. I can have that in two weeks from the day you send the photos.
Anyone at the shop can take the photos with a phone; good light is enough. If you prefer, I can pass on the details of a photographer who charges by the day.
Then, in December, the company page and the blog, which are not urgent.
The total price stays the same, but you can pay it in two parts, one per delivery. If that works, I will send the plan with dates on Friday.

Best,
Julia
